title: Corporate Governance Section 6: Policy and Procedures for Dealing in the Securities of Lycopodium Limited

tiers.name: Directors, Officers, Employees
tiers.description: Directors, officers and employees of Lycopodium Limited and its subsidiaries, and their associates. Subject at all times to the insider trading ban, discouragement from short-term trading, and (outside a Closed Period) a post-trade notification duty.

tiers.name: Directors and Officers
tiers.description: A director or officer of Lycopodium Limited, and a director or secretary of a subsidiary, and their associates. Distinguished as the group barred from trading during a Closed Period, and as the group eligible for exceptional-circumstances sale clearance during a Closed Period.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors specifically, who under Corporations Act s205G must notify ASX of any acquisition or disposal of Lycopodium securities and forward a copy of that notice to the Company Secretary.

windows.start_anchor: close of the financial year (30 June)
windows.end_anchor: release of the financial results for the full year

windows.start_anchor: close of the half year (31 December)
windows.end_anchor: release of the financial results for the half year

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may designate other periods as a 'Closed Period' by resolution. Not stated whether confidential.

rules.detail: Derivatives and third-party financial products are not mentioned. 'Security' is defined as shares, debentures, rights, options, employee options, prescribed interests and warrants issued by or in respect of Lycopodium itself, with no reference to OTC or exchange-traded products issued by a third party.
Hedging is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
No concept of monetisation, prepaid forwards or agreements creating economic exposure is addressed. 'Deal' is defined only as a transaction associated with buying, selling or converting a security.
Short selling is not named; only 'short term trading' (a distinct concept) is discouraged.
CFDs are not mentioned and are not captured by the narrow 'security'/'deal' definitions.
Margin loans are not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Granting a charge, lien or pledge over securities is not mentioned and is not covered by the 'deal' definition (buying, selling or converting a security).
No secured financing provision of any kind exists in the policy.
Blanket, undefined discouragement of short-term trading, expressed as 'should never' rather than 'must not'; no period, basis or carve-outs given.
rules.evidence: should never engage in short term trading of any securities of Lycopodium Limited

clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary, or in his absence, a director
clearance.evidence: in a period, other than a Closed Period, should advise the Company Secretary, or in his absence, a director, of any purchase or sale of securities in Lycopodium Limited within two business days.

clearance.approver: Chairman (or the Managing Director if the Chairman is the person involved)
clearance.evidence: the person must obtain written approval from the Chairman, or if the Chairman is involved, the Managing Director, to trade in the securities of Lycopodium Limited. This approval, shall be valid for a period of no longer than two weeks and is to be reported at the next Board meeting

short_term.evidence: should never engage in short term trading of any securities of Lycopodium Limited

exceptions.evidence: the trading results in no change in beneficial interest in the securities
the trading occurs via investments in a scheme or other arrangement where the investment decisions are exercised by a third party
the restricted person has no control or influence with respect to trading decisions
the trading occurs under an offer to all or most of the security holders of the entity
acquire securities in Lycopodium Limited under a bonus issue made to all holders of securities of the same class
acquire securities of Lycopodium Limited under a dividend reinvestment, or top-up plan that is available to all holders of securities of the same class
acquire, or agree to acquire, shares or options under any employee share or option plan implemented by Lycopodium Limited
exercise options granted by Lycopodium Limited ... but may only sell all or part of the shares received upon exercise of the options only in accordance with the above Policy and these Procedures

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Managing Director if the Chairman is involved)
exceptions.evidence: a restricted person may be in severe financial hardship and has a pressing financial commitment that cannot be satisfied otherwise than by selling the securities of Lycopodium Limited

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Managing Director if the Chairman is involved)
exceptions.evidence: a restricted person is required by a court order, or there are court enforceable undertakings, to transfer or sell the securities of the entity or there is some other overriding legal or regulatory requirement for him or her to do so

exceptions.approver: Chairman (or Managing Director if the Chairman is involved)
exceptions.evidence: other circumstances, which may be deemed exceptional by the Chairman or the Managing Director (where the Chairman is the person involved) and whereby prior written clearance is granted to permit trading

exemption_authority: Chairman (or Managing Director if the Chairman is the person involved) may grant prior written clearance for a director, officer or their associate to sell or dispose of securities during a Closed Period for severe financial hardship, court order/enforceable undertaking, or other circumstances deemed exceptional; approval is limited to sale/disposal, valid no more than two weeks, and must be reported at the next Board meeting.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no derivatives, hedging or secured financing regime
bespoke_clauses.clause: "security" includes shares, debentures, rights, options, employee options, prescribed interests and warrants. "deal" includes any transaction associated with buying, selling or converting a security.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The policy has no concept of derivatives, hedging, margin loans or secured financing, so an OTC collar and a loan secured on the collared shares sit entirely outside its express dealing definition and are tested only against the general insider-trading ban, Closed Periods and short-term trading discouragement, with no bespoke approval or disclosure route.

bespoke_clauses.clause: This approval, shall be valid for a period of no longer than two weeks and is to be reported at the next Board meeting
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any Closed Period sale executed to fund or unwind part of a collar under the hardship/exceptional-circumstances route becomes a matter of Board record and must complete within two weeks of approval.

bespoke_clauses.clause: a director must notify the Australian Stock Exchange Limited of the acquisition or disposal of any security of Lycopodium Limited. A copy of any such notification should be forwarded ... to the Lycopodium Limited Company Secretary within 2 business days of a deal occurring.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Collar entry or unwind by a director triggers a separate s205G ASX notification and internal reporting duty within 2 business days, independent of the general 2-business-day post-trade notice.

bespoke_clauses.clause: in a period, other than a Closed Period, should advise the Company Secretary, or in his absence, a director, of any purchase or sale of securities in Lycopodium Limited within two business days.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Outside a Closed Period there is no prior-approval gate at all for dealing in Lycopodium securities, only a post-trade notice, so collar execution timing is not constrained by a clearance process (only by the insider-trading ban and Closed Periods).

summary: This 2010-era policy does not mention derivatives, hedging, margin lending, secured financing, encumbrance, CFDs, short selling or stock lending, so an OTC collar and a loan secured on the collared shares fall entirely outside its express terms. Outside a Closed Period, a director, officer, employee or associate may deal in Lycopodium securities without any prior clearance, provided they hold no inside information, and need only notify the Company Secretary (or a director) of the purchase or sale within two business days; directors must also separately notify ASX under s205G within two business days. During the Closed Period (financial year-end or half-year-end to results release, or a Board-declared period), directors, officers, subsidiary directors/secretaries and their associates are barred from trading, subject to a narrow Chairman/Managing-Director-approved sale-only exception for severe financial hardship, court order or other exceptional circumstances, valid no more than two weeks and reported to the Board. Because the policy has no bespoke financing or derivatives regime, a funded collar would need to be assessed purely against the insider-trading ban, the (undefined) discouragement of short-term trading, and the applicable Closed Period, with entry, unwind or settlement executed outside those periods and, for directors, promptly notified to ASX and the Company Secretary.
